newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's trade gap to hit $1.5 bln in Feb - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's trade gap to hit $1.5 bln in Feb - paper.

text.p: Brazil's trade deficit in February is likely to hit $1.5 billion if the government considers fuel imports by Petrobras which had not been registered last month, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper said.
Even without considering Petrobras's purchases of oil, February's trade deficit will top $1 billion, the newspaper added.

Brazil posted a $413 million trade gap in January amid problems with the Siscomex import registration system. Last month, the Siscomex registered only $60 million in fuel imports by Petrobras, instead of $533 million actually imported by the company, Gazeta said.
